head: 4ebe1665496c5e99f2fb579015d3a98963a229cc
scope: DNS dotted/network conversion, atomic U8/U16 length readers, DNS-name validity, record-name short-circuit orchestration, ASCII ordering and URL canonicalization result/fallback selection.
remaining_cpp_seams: Exported public C++ APIs and string/vector/span ownership adaptation. DomainNameComparator remains inline and calls exported C++ DomainNameLess.
SpanReader callback commits and bounded post-commit copies. Rust controls parsing and callback order; cursor/input alias semantics preserved.

Existing IsCanonicalizedHostCompliant, HostStringIsLocalhost, IPAddress::AssignFromIPLiteral, ParseURLHostnameToAddress. Rust owns their ordering; local service algorithms stay outside this component.
URL CanonicalizeHostVerbose, StdStringCanonOutput and ICU/IDNA, URL IPv4/IPv6 numeric parsing. Rust selects canonicalized versus original bytes.

safety.ffi: CXX generated layouts/ownership; no authored raw-pointer dereferences or unsafe blocks. Host inputs callback-scoped. Reader slices end before cursor mutation; returned LabelChunk initialized to zero before post-commit copy. Public output spans never borrowed as initialized Rust outputs.
safety.atomic_reads: Failure leaves cursor and output span unchanged; success commits output before reader.
safety.network_failures: Compression rejects before current read; incomplete label atomic; completed oversized label/name consumes its bytes before failure.

coverage_inputs: all 65,536 two-byte values and 256 single bytes
all 256 label-prefix values x 260 available lengths, both at start and after a completed label
all 65,536 U16 lengths with exact/truncated/extra availability
name sizes 0..519 with NUL/dot/ASCII/non-ASCII content and structured multibyte wire names
nonzero initial cursors, input cursor-object aliases, output span-object aliases, trailing/root/compression cases

fuzz.instrumentation: C++ libFuzzer edge/cmp instrumentation; full public Rust-backed APIs differentially asserted. Rust line/region coverage collected separately via instrument-coverage.

coverage.method: Chromium rustc -Cinstrument-coverage; LLVM profile merge/export from final native unit executable
coverage.branch_coverage: Not collected; zero branch records is not branch coverage.
coverage.runtime_exclusions: No exclusions within the two authored Rust files. Other Chromium/vendor/platform source files are outside this authored Rust coverage claim. No C++ line coverage claim.

clippy.method: cargo check --release with RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER set to configured Chromium clippy-driver.exe and RUSTFLAGS += -Dwarnings
clippy.note: Initial older stable Clippy failed on CXX syntax; matching bundled Chromium driver passes.

native_build.method: Configured Chromium compiler/flags and existing dependencies; actual production dns_names_util.cc compiled directly. Separate exact external-service bodies extracted for focused native linkage, not substitute DNS parsing. No GN/Ninja or configured-tree modifications.
native_build.cpp_flags: Full response files archived separately in unit-rsp/fuzz-rsp/bench-rsp; /O2, /clang:-O2, /std:c++23preview, /MD, COMPONENT_BUILD, DCHECK_ALWAYS_ON, NET_IMPLEMENTATION, Chromium plugins and configured sanitizers. Native fuzz adds inline-8bit-counters,pc-table,trace-cmp.
native_build.rust_flags: -Cdebug-assertions=yes -Ccontrol-flow-guard=yes -Cpanic=abort; release opt-level=3/codegen-units=1. Coverage adds -Cinstrument-coverage. Clippy adds -Dwarnings.
